description: Synthetic sesslint.repair.vetting parity (_plan_step_identity json.dumps seam, source_hash checks, planner register_all seam).
known_parity_gaps: GAP-vetting-json-dumps: _plan_step_identity calls json.dumps(sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')). Rust returns json.dumps is not available and does not emit canonical JSON text.

GAP-vetting-register-all: vet_plan calls planner_plan, which imports sesslint.repair.recipes_conservative.register_all. Rust stops at that seam and does not compare supplied steps to the derived plan.

GAP-vetting-step-comparison: after planner_plan returns, Python compares each supplied step via _plan_step_identity and may raise RepairRefused. Rust never reaches step comparison because register_all is unavailable.
